subject: reasoning
question:
Select the number from among the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

16, 9, 27, 19, 76, 67, 335, ?
solution:
Given: 16, 9, 27, 19, 76, 67, 335, ?

The logic followed here is:

It is an alternate series,

 
• **Here a natural number (starting from 7) is subtracted from the first number.**
 
• **The second number is multiplied with a natural number (starting from 3), **as shown below,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9449898b7c118262a3f8abc336d3494c04e4332ad6161a3f16bd1661b36010cd.png] 

Hence, **325 **is the correct answer.
